Fact.Name: Allocated USVI deduction, line 22
Fact.Description: Form 8689 line 22, the self-employed SEP, SIMPLE and qualified plan deduction attributable to USVI income: the deduction the return takes on Schedule 1 line 16 multiplied by the USVI share of self-employment income (USVI source self-employment income divided by worldwide self-employment income, at most one). The deduction is read from the return itself, so it is never entered a second time for this form; $0 when the return takes no Schedule 1 line 16 deduction or has no USVI self-employment income.

Fact.Name: USVI IRA deductions, allocated separately by spouse
Fact.Description: Form 8689 line 25, the IRA deductions attributable to USVI compensation or earned income, figured separately for each spouse: the primary filer's Schedule 1 line 20 IRA deduction (the ordinary traditional IRA deduction plus the section 219(f)(6) deduction of a prior-year excess contribution) times the primary filer's USVI share of compensation, plus the spouse's Schedule 1 line 20 IRA deduction (the spouse's ordinary deduction plus the spouse's own section 219(f)(6) deduction, IRC 219(f)(2)) times the spouse's USVI share. Each deduction is read from the return itself, so it is never entered a second time for this form; the spouse term is $0 on a return with no spouse IRA deduction.

Fact.Name: Allocation ratio, at least three decimal places and capped at one
Fact.Description: Retains nine decimal places instead of rounding to only three places. A nonpositive worldwide AGI with nonzero USVI AGI requires a supported special allocation; it remains incomplete instead of dividing by zero or inventing a ratio.

Fact.Name: Tax allocated to the USVI
Fact.Description: Form 8689 line 36: line 33 times line 35, the tax allocated to the USVI, never below $0. Line 32 subtracts the refundable credits from the total tax, so line 33 can be negative for a low-income filer; a negative allocation is not a tax the filer is required to pay to the USVI, so line 36 floors at $0, line 41 is then $0 and every USVI payment on line 40 is an overpayment on line 42.

Fact.Name: USVI income tax withheld that is not on a Form W-2VI entered on this return
Fact.Description: Question: "How much U.S. Virgin Islands income tax was withheld from your income, other than the box 2 amounts of the Forms W-2VI you entered?" Help text: Form 8689 line 37 includes the USVI income tax withheld (box 2 of Form W-2VI); the box 2 amounts of the Forms W-2VI on this return are added for you. Do not include this amount on the federal income tax withheld lines. Enter 0 if there is none. Asked when the return files Form 8689. Unanswered: line 37 and the Form 8689 credit are Incomplete. Validation: dollars, not less than $0. Feeds /form8689Line37.
